name: The House Built Out of Names

rooms.name: Road of Appointments
rooms.purpose: The house ahead is built of civic roles. Read the three plates that are physically here. Nothing outside this road is required.
rooms.layoutNote: A straight approach. Four fence posts split the verges. Three plates stand in the south half. The north door is the house.

dialogue.text: The doors inside are offices. If a role has no plate, it has no floor.

objects.name: House milestone
objects.inscription: THE HOUSE ADMITS WHO HAS READ THE THREE PLATES.

steps.note: Read the clerk plate on the west verge.
Read the lister plate.
Read the fence-viewer plate.
Touch the milestone once all three plates are read. The north door unlatches.
Enter the house.

solutionTrace: 1. Read the clerk plate on the west verge. | action=interact | target=plate-clerk | tool=none | requires=none | sets=dg13.plate.clerk
2. Read the lister plate. | action=interact | target=plate-lister | tool=none | requires=none | sets=dg13.plate.lister
3. Read the fence-viewer plate. | action=interact | target=plate-fence | tool=none | requires=none | sets=dg13.plate.fence

4. Touch the milestone once all three plates are read. The north door unlatches. | action=interact | target=milestone | tool=none | requires=dg13.plate.clerk & dg13.plate.lister & dg13.plate.fence | sets=dg13.platesRead
5. Enter the house. | action=traverse | exit=north | tool=none | requires=dg13.platesRead | sets=none
6. Room clear is recorded as cleared.DG13.R01. Death does not erase it.

rooms.name: Vestibule of Offices
rooms.purpose: Only the clerk's door is an office yet. The other labels are painted on plaster and do not open.
rooms.layoutNote: A counter broken at the center aisle. The clerk plate is east of the aisle. North is the cage. South returns to the road.

dialogue.text: State the office you are entering. The tube only answers to the plate.

rooms.name: Clerk's Cage
rooms.purpose: Copy the day's appointments into the field book. The book, not memory, is what later rooms check.
rooms.layoutNote: A cage of bars occupies the east. The book-ledge is west of the bars. The appointment board is fixed to the south of the cage.

dialogue.text: Copy the board. I do not repeat names that are not on it.

objects.name: Appointment board
objects.inscription: TODAY: CLERK, LISTER, FENCE VIEWER, CONSTABLE, SELECTBOARD, ROAD COMMISSIONER, OVERSEER, TRUSTEE, MILL AGENT, FERRY TENDER.

rooms.name: Listers' Gallery
rooms.purpose: A disputed lot line is drawn on the floor. Measure it with the chain. The length is painted on the wall of this room.
rooms.layoutNote: A long gallery. A false wall stands west of the aisle. The painted length is on the east plaster. The lot line runs along y=6 from x=3 to x=7.

dialogue.text: The paint says four rods. Your chain agrees or the false wall stays.

objects.name: Disputed lot line
objects.note: The chain latches only at the painted length of 4.

rooms.name: Fence Viewers' Walk
rooms.purpose: The legal width of the walk is one coat less than a body. Hang the coat, then hold the gate with the rod.
rooms.layoutNote: A narrow stile. The west wall thickens into a passage one tile wide at x=7,y=5..7, leaving x=8 open beside the center aisle's neighbor. Peg and gate are south of the stile.

dialogue.text: A body with its coat on does not fit the viewer's width.

objects.note: Falls shut unless a range rod is planted in the socket.

rooms.name: Constable's Lock
rooms.purpose: A filled warrant is tied to the lock with red tape. Cut the tape or stamp the warrant. Either opens the lock. The method is remembered and does not gate the house.
rooms.layoutNote: A lockup bench against the west wall. The warrant hangs east. The aisle stays open.

dialogue.text: The tape is the lock. The seal is also the lock. I accept either.

objects.name: Filled warrant
objects.inscription: WARRANT ALREADY NAMED. TAPE IS RED. SEAL BOX IS OPEN.

rooms.name: Selectboard Horseshoe
rooms.purpose: Three chairs. The roll board lists the ring order. Ring each marked spot once, in that order. A repeat before the next name stands the member back up.
rooms.layoutNote: Horseshoe of benches leaving the center aisle. Three bell spots sit on the inner curve. The board is north of them.

dialogue.text: We sit when the bell hits the right spot in the right order.

rooms.name: Commissioner's Cut
rooms.purpose: The floor road is broken by a gap of the length painted beside it. The chain bridges that posted length and no other.
rooms.layoutNote: Center aisle interrupted by void at (9,5). Side floors let you stand at the near post (9 is void, so the post is at x=7,y=5 and the far hook at x=11,y=5).

dialogue.text: The paint says the gap is one chain-length, marked 4. I will not tell you a second number.

hazards.note: Walking the void tile without the bridge is a fall.

rooms.name: Overseer's Bench
rooms.purpose: Critical witness. The bench looks blank until the lamp shows gouged names. Reading them is the same act as opening the north door.
rooms.layoutNote: A waiting room. The bench fills the west. The north door is dark until the scratches are lit.

dialogue.text: If the bench is blank, you have not lit it. I do not keep a second list.

objects.name: Gouged bench
objects.inscription: UNDER THE LAMP: OTTER CREW, NIGHT, NO LINE ON THE LIST.
objects.note: The inscription is not visible until the lamp is used. The use writes it into the field book.

rooms.name: Trustee's Landings
rooms.purpose: Three landings pretend to be the stair. The plumb shows the vertical one. The other two return you to the bottom without a death.
rooms.layoutNote: Three pads at y=4. Only the center-east pad is true. A sign at the bottom states that the bob, not the banister, is the stair.

dialogue.text: Children are not in this stair. Grades are landings. Only one is vertical.

objects.name: Landing sign
objects.inscription: THE BOB NAMES THE TRUE LANDING. FALSE LANDINGS PUT YOU BACK AT THIS SIGN.

objects.name: West landing
objects.note: False. Returns you to the sign.

objects.name: Mid landing
objects.note: False. Returns you to the sign.

objects.name: True landing
objects.note: The plumb hangs square only here.

rooms.name: Mill Agent's Desk
rooms.purpose: Align the glass on the two posts whose numbers match. The mill decision changes the desk's papers and never the door.
rooms.layoutNote: A desk west. Two numbered posts stand east of the aisle, off the landing column.

dialogue.text: I file whatever the mill became. The posts are the door, not my papers.

textByDecision.prepared: The settlement you helped the mill keep is copied here, unsigned by the office.
textByDecision.neglected: The desk's mill page is blank. No one wrote that you helped.
textByDecision.opposed: The page records you with the office against the mill's unlisted race.
textByDecision.unknown: The mill page has no record yet. The posts still work.

rooms.name: Antechamber of the Empty Chair
rooms.purpose: The mayor's peg will lock the next door if you hang a coat on it. Leave it empty on purpose.
rooms.layoutNote: A row of office pegs along the west. The mayor peg is marked EMPTY and stands apart at x=13,y=4. The aisle is clear.

dialogue.text: Every office has a peg. The mayor's peg is the one that must stay empty.

objects.name: Office pegs
objects.inscription: CLERK, LISTER, FENCE VIEWER, CONSTABLE. NONE OF THESE IS THE DOOR.

persistence.note: Choosing the empty peg survives death. A coat hung here and not retrieved remains as a previous body after death and still blocks the door until taken off.

rooms.name: Chamber of the Empty Mayor
rooms.purpose: Boss. Adjourn the vacancy. Do not become it.
rooms.layoutNote: A horseshoe dais. The chair is north of center but off the door column, at x=6,y=3. Three roll doors are painted on the east wall as objects. The ordinance lectern is west.

dialogue.text: Motion: that a body be assigned the chair.
Ordinance: a mayor must be a name.

objects.name: Appointment ribbon
objects.note: Appears if you sit. The knife cuts it.

objects.name: Roll board
objects.inscription: 1 EAST DOOR, 2 MIDDLE DOOR, 3 WEST DOOR.

Ring the first door on the roll board.
Ring the third door. The roll closes.
Write the ordinance line already printed: vacant.
